text: だいじに　そだてなさいよ！

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい after a verb is a firm but kind order, like a parent or teacher gives. そだてなさい = 'raise it'.

patterns.name: 〜に (how)
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word like だいじ turns it into the way something is done. だいじに = 'with care'.
